dz: 春秋时期的干时之战：齐国君主公孙无知死后，鲁庄公派兵进入齐国，试图拥立流亡的齐国公子纠为新君，却在干时被公子纠的兄弟、争位对手、新即位的齐桓公击败。
de: Spring and Autumn period: Battle of Qianshi: Upon the death of the previous Duke of Qi, Gongsun Wuzhi, Duke Zhuang of Lu sends an army into the Duchy of Qi to install the exiled Qi prince Gongzi Jiu as the new Duke of Qi – but is defeated at Qianshi by Jiu's brother and rival claimant, the newly inaugurated Duke Huan of Qi.
